title: Builder BLD-105: Generated Tune rail, two layers

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-105.

detail:
B1 Shell, pass BLD-105 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-105). Generated Tune rail, two layers. Scope: components/builder/tune. Build: Layer 1 renders slots.required then slots.optional, from role.json, with counts from slot limits. Layer 2 (More): tone, width, spacing, columns, devices, anchor, reveal, density per surface, from defineBlock.fields. 'Always show more' per person. Done when: For every adopted role, rendered fields equal the projection, no more and no fewer; No component file names a block type. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:blocks, a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-104. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Generated Tune rail: lib/builder/tune.ts projects any block into layer 1 (role slots, required first, with character and list limits; or a non-role block's text, list and picture fields) and layer 2 under More (variant, tone, look, live). Test: for every adopted role the drawn fields equal the declared fields, no more and no fewer. components/builder/tune names no block type; Always show more is kept per person; typing in one field is one undo step (burst in lib/builder/state.ts). Canvas and Tune edit the same draft.
